news.headline: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) out for several weeks with broken wrist
news.impact: Lane was seeing some promising usage before exiting with his injury, having a touchdown nullified by holding, another endzone target just out of his reach, and an 11-yard gain on his one reception.
